HOW IT WORKS

Move business data through a controlled workflow

Reliable data movement begins with choosing the correct records, applying useful filters, and reviewing the resulting file. Supported exports are available today; the planned import workflow is designed to check structure, required fields, and formatting issues before any records are processed.

01

Choose the records

Select invoices, customers, products, expenses, reports, or another supported area based on the work you need to complete.

02

Apply useful filters

Limit the file by date range, status, customer, item, or other available criteria so it contains only the relevant records.

03

Generate and review the export

Create the supported Excel, PDF, or print output and confirm its columns, totals, dates, and record coverage.

04

Validate before importing

The planned import workflow checks file structure, required fields, duplicates, and formatting problems before records are approved for processing.

WHY IT MATTERS

Protect record quality when data moves

Controlled data movement protects record quality. A useful export contains the right records and filters; a safe import identifies problems before they become permanent business data.

01

Work with focused datasets

Choosing a record type and applying filters produces files that are easier to review, reconcile, and share responsibly.

02

Catch problems before processing

Validation warnings can reveal missing required values, invalid dates, duplicates, and formatting problems before records are added.

03

Preserve an audit trail

Keeping source files, exports, mappings, warnings, and approval details makes a large data operation easier to explain and verify.

PRACTICAL CHECKLIST

Use import and export with confidence well

  • Keep an unchanged copy of every original source file.
  • Export the relevant existing records before a large data operation.
  • Review filters, columns, formats, totals, and record counts.
  • Resolve every critical validation warning before approving an import.
Always confirm the legal, tax, and record-keeping requirements that apply to your business.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about import and export with confidence

Which export formats are supported?

The verified application includes Excel export for supported lists and reporting views, plus PDF generation for supported documents and statements.

Can I import a complete CSV or Excel file today?

Broad business-record importing was not verified in the application repository and remains planned. Review the active application before relying on an import workflow.

What will pre-import validation check?

The planned workflow is intended to identify structural problems, missing required values, invalid formats, duplicates, and other issues before records are processed.

Can I filter records before exporting?

Supported areas can provide relevant filters such as date range, status, customer, or item. Confirm the active filters and resulting record count before generating the file.

Should I keep a backup before importing?

Yes. Preserve the original source file and export the relevant existing records before any large data operation so changes can be reviewed and reconciled.

Does exporting data replace accounting reconciliation?

No. Exported files support review and transfer, but totals and records should still be reconciled with the systems and professional requirements used by your business.
